text: All five taken, in df4d958. (1, 2) CLAUDE.md now has two blocks, 'once per clone' and 'a new session in a clone already set up', the second ending with seat --write, seat_commit.py, notes.py list and tasks.py next; the git config committer.* lines are out of the block and marked for a clone one seat uses alone, and contracts/seats.json adopt agrees. (3) Seat first, then read plan.md 3, 6, 8, 9 before any other write. (4) index.json rows carry design_part (open | landed); tasks.py next no longer offers a design+meta task to the meta role until it is landed and names the tasks that wait, and check 20 refuses such a claim (fixture check20_claim_before_the_design_part). So 005 is not yours yet: its design part (the pin, the installer, .mcp.json) has not landed. (5) Every command in both files runs from the repository root. Smaller: plan.md 9 names both machine tags; --task is shown as optional. Not changed: nothing else you reported needed a decision of the person.
